doc.name: Best Ceremonies
doc.instructions: Read-only facts about Best Ceremonies, the business of Felicity Best, registered marriage celebrant based in Murwillumbah, NSW: published prices, an itemised estimate for a place and day, where ceremonies are held, the paperwork, and any page in full. Quote prices as given; they are published to be quoted. Cite the page URL each answer names. Nothing here books, holds or checks a date, and no tool sends an enquiry. To book, give the person the phone number or the contact page that bestceremonies_contact returns.

tools.name: bestceremonies_prices
tools.title: Ceremony prices
tools.description: Every published ceremony price for Best Ceremonies (Felicity Best, marriage and funeral celebrant, Murwillumbah NSW): weekday and weekend figures in AUD, with what each includes and whether GST applies. Quote these directly.

tools.name: bestceremonies_estimate
tools.title: Estimate a ceremony's total
tools.description: Itemised total for one ceremony: the tier's fee for the day, travel beyond the included kilometres, witnesses supplied, booking fee and balance. Arithmetic is the same as the estimator on the prices page.

service.description: Service id or name, e.g. weddings, elopements, legals-only, funerals

tier.description: Tier name when the service has more than one; defaults to the first

day.description: weekday = Monday to Thursday, weekend = Friday to Sunday

place.description: One of the site's places, e.g. Byron Bay, Gold Coast, Scenic Rim, or a further-afield one such as Brisbane; or omit and give km

km.description: One-way road kilometres from Murwillumbah, if the place is not listed

tools.name: bestceremonies_service
tools.title: One ceremony in detail
tools.description: What one ceremony type includes, costs, needs (documents) and how far ahead to book, with the page's own questions and answers.

service.description: Service id or name, e.g. elopements

tools.name: bestceremonies_areas
tools.title: Where ceremonies are held
tools.description: Where Best Ceremonies (Felicity Best, marriage and funeral celebrant, Murwillumbah NSW) holds ceremonies: each place with its state, drive time and distance from Murwillumbah, venues, and which ceremony pages exist for it, then the places reached by arrangement (e.g. Brisbane) with the travel charge for the drive.

tools.name: bestceremonies_faq
tools.title: Search the questions and answers
tools.description: Search every question and answer on the site (paperwork, the NOIM, permits, witnesses, timing, funerals, prices).

query.description: One or two words, e.g. permit

tools.name: bestceremonies_contact
tools.title: How to get in touch
tools.description: How to get in touch, what is published about the business, what is not yet, and what this site cannot do (it books nothing and no tool sends the enquiry form).

tools.name: bestceremonies_page
tools.title: Read one page
tools.description: Read one page of this site in full, as Markdown: its answer, prices, steps, questions and every other word a person sees. Give the page's path, e.g. /weddings/, /areas/byron-bay/ or /noim/. The other tools name the pages worth reading.

path.description: A path on this site, e.g. /weddings/ or /areas/byron-bay/
